Constant.text: v0.1.2: improve vertical speed readout positioning when time unit is set to seconds instead of minutes.
v0.1.3: center pitch ladder on boresight when prograde's angle from boresight exceeds threshold.
v0.1.4: add runway projection for DSC 09/27 and clean up code.
v0.1.5: add support for up to three concurrently-rendering runways (tunable), cull runays more than 20 km away, add runway information for DSC 13/31, reduce width of speed readout.
v0.1.6: left align Mach, g, and alpha readout labels, and remove flight logs.
v0.1.7: optimize code by removing custom expression calls and converting to fUNK for the main HUD thread. Allocation rate: 11 MiB/s -> 2.3 MiB/s. Average FPS: 83 FPS -> 86 FPS.

v0.1.8: invert g readout when aircraft is experiencing negative vertical gs, auto-change between ASL and AGL, remove pitch ladder rung ellipses to reduce the number of widgets, add loading text, and fix heading tape labels.

v0.2.0: deactivate and hide the HUD when the camera is far away, add terrain text and voice caution and warning, add landing gear text and voice caution, reduce the number of pitch ladder rungs being rendered for performance, move runway ASL variable entry to under each runway,

add longitude offset to runway projection to account for running out of instructions per frame, remove non-optimized reference code, remove unused custom expressions, parent the heading tape, left, and right readouts to the boresight to reduce the number of instructions,
wrap main HUD moving loop inside if frame delta time > 0 to stop it from running when time has not passed.
v0.2.1: parent the prograde marker to boresight to reduce the amount of computation required, move boresight declaration earlier so later components can use it as parent directly
